Interface IFragmentAtom

All Superinterfaces:
Cloneable, IAtom, IAtomType, ICDKObject, IChemObject, IElement, IIsotope, IPseudoAtom
All Known Implementing Classes:
DebugFragmentAtom, FragmentAtom, FragmentAtom
public interface IFragmentAtom extends IPseudoAtom
Class to represent an IPseudoAtom which embeds an IAtomContainer. Very much like the MDL molfile Group concept.
Author:
egonw
